name: Ferocious Horde [Selfish, Teamwork]
body:
Seeing a fellow orc bleed makes you fight harder.

Prerequisite(s): Orc, ferocity ancestral trait.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are at or below half of your full hit points and an orc ally within 30 feet is also at or below half of their full hit points, you gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls.
